01Solutions

Every line. One platform.

From end-of-line packing to humanoids, the automation American manufacturing actually needs, deployed for zero dollars in capital investment.

Any-Product Palletizing
Stable stacks, every shift
Any-Product Palletizing
Vision-guided palletizing that adapts to product, pattern, and pallet on the fly. Varying SKUs, fast changeovers, AI that keeps getting sharper with every cycle.
Case Packing
Counts that hit, every time
Case Packing
Vision-powered intelligent pick and place, top & side load, rigid & flexible packages. Changes over in minutes.
Machine Tending
Mill, lathe, mold · hands off and lights out
Machine Tending
Robotic part loading and unloading for CNC mills, lathes, and injection molders. Pushes spindle utilization past 80%, runs lights-out shifts, and frees skilled operators for setup and QC.
Pallet Wrapping
Tight wraps, dock-ready
Pallet Wrapping
Automated stretch wrapping integrated with your palletizer and AMR flow. Consistent wrap tension, no operator walks, no damaged loads on the dock.
General Purpose Robots
On-demand intelligent problem solver
General Purpose Robots
Frontier general-purpose robots deployed under the same Full Service model: fixed monthly price, no integration risk, continuous capability upgrades as the platforms mature. Early access program open now.
Material Movement
Pallet movement without forklifts
Material Movement
Autonomous mobile robots moving pallets dock-to-staging, line-to-wrap, finished-goods-to-outbound. Scales from 2 to 30+ units, and slows around people automatically.
Formic Fast Track
Your entire end of line, one low monthly fee
Formic Fast Track
The easiest way to automate your entire end of line. Case erecting, packing, sealing, and palletizing, scoped and installed as one connected line, for one low monthly fee.

02The Magic

AI on the floor.
Production-grade.

Industrial AI built for shop-floor reality. Vision systems, learned policies, and continuous improvement, running safely on every Formic line, getting smarter with every cycle.

Inside the Magic
Cortex · The AI layer
01 / Cortex

The intelligence layer across every Formic system.

Cortex runs perception, decision-making, and continuous learning across every cell. Fleet-wide vision models, anomaly detection, and policy improvements roll out as OTA updates. Your systems get smarter every week.

  • Vision models trained on millions of in-line cycles
  • Closed-loop learning: every cycle improves the model
  • Continuous OTA upgrades, new capability, no downtime
Core · Safe execution
02 / Core

Safe execution. At industrial speed.

Core is the execution layer that runs Cortex's decisions in deterministic, safety-rated motion, the layer that keeps AI honest on the floor. Hard-real-time control, certified safety paths, no surprises on the line.

  • Hard-real-time motion, deterministic to the millisecond
  • Safety-rated stop and intervention paths
  • The trusted handoff between AI policy and physical motion
